name: en-passant
description: Build and train your chess repertoire.
author: Guillaume Salles

scripts.dev:local: bash -c 'until curl -fsS http://localhost:8788/api/auth/get-session >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; LOCAL_FUNCTIONS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8788 vite --host localhost'
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:main
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:build:main && concurrently --kill-others --success first "vite --host localhost --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.desktop:test:e2e: npm run desktop:build && playwright test --config playwright.electron.config.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name enpassant
scripts.lint: oxlint src tests scripts electron --deny-warnings -A no-unassigned-vars
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:filenames && npm run check:guardrails && npm run type-check && npm test -- --run && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && node scripts/run-e2e.mjs --offline
